question: Who among the following was the Sultan of Delhi sultanate from 1296 A.D. to 1316 A.D.?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Khalji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Alauddin Khalji** ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1296 A.D. to 1316 A.D.
 
• He was the second ruler of the Khalji dynasty.
 
• Alauddin is known for his military conquests, including the successful campaigns against the Mongols.
 
• He implemented significant administrative reforms and economic policies to control the market prices and strengthen the central authority.
 
• His rule is marked by the construction of the Alai Darwaza, a gateway at the Qutb complex in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi Sultanate**

 
 
• The Delhi Sultanate was a Muslim kingdom based in Delhi that ruled large parts of the Indian subcontinent for 320 years (1206–1526).
 
• It was founded by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, a former slave of Muhammad Ghori.
 
• The Sultanate was divided into five dynasties: the Mamluk, Khalji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, and Lodi dynasties.
 
 
 
• **Khalji Dynasty**
 
 
• The Khalji dynasty ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1290 to 1320.
 
• It was founded by Jalal-ud-din Khalji.
 
• The dynasty is known for its military campaigns and expansionist policies.
 
 
 
• **Market Reforms of Alauddin Khalji**
 
 
• Alauddin is known for his market control policy to regulate prices of essential commodities.
 
• He established state granaries to store surplus grain and control supply.
 
• Strict measures were put in place to prevent hoarding and black marketing.
 
 
 
• **Military Campaigns**
 
 
• Alauddin Khalji expanded his empire through various military campaigns in the Deccan, Gujarat, and Rajasthan.
 
• He successfully repelled multiple Mongol invasions, securing the northern borders of his empire.
